content: Streamlit 1.67 supports app themes in .streamlit/config.toml, including separate dark/light variants; theme configuration covers background, secondary background, text, primary color, borders, and typography. Official best practices recommend theme settings before CSS because internal selectors can change, and recommend keyed st-key-* selectors for scoped CSS when needed. st.container(border=True,key=...) supplies stable card identity and a scoped key class; st.columns offers wrapping at 640px and cautions against nesting beyond one level.
